request: Review common teleport loading so characters remain on destination objects instead of falling before those objects stream.
status: Core fix built and automated checks passed; cold-client rendering and movement release remain unverified in game.
confirmed_source_findings: Initial self creation previously preceded ordinary grid gameobject creation. The existing early-object path covered only map-object transports, with the hold restricted to map 0 / entry 246854 / 75 yards.
Map::GetHeight passed DynamicTreeCallback* to DynamicMapTree::getHeight's preceding bool argument. The implicit conversion discarded the actual supporting-object callback.
Near teleport packets do not serialize complete self movement flags. An already-known self requires explicit gravity/root orders.
Movement and movement ACK relocation could replace protected position/flags; an early loading-screen completion could be lost before the hold began.
implementation: Load destination grids, gather visible ordinary GOs and map-object transports, and trace the real phase-visible dynamic floor within two units of the destination. Send these creates before self creation or near-teleport coordinates.
Forward the collision callback to the correct native argument. Include a supporting object's create even if its origin lies outside the ordinary search radius.

Use common floor-based protection instead of the Dalaran entry whitelist. Hold gravity and movement for newly created floors or distant arrivals; short same-map blinks on an already-known floor remain immediate.
Handle near/seamless transfers with explicit movement orders and their completion path; cache early loading completion. Ignore movement relocation while protection is active.

Preserve independent root and gravity auras; clean up on departure, death, map change, transport/vehicle boarding, completion or timeout. Defer new creature/pet visibility only for the arriving observer.

timing_and_limits.policy: Existing bounded grace retained and generalized. LoadingScreenNotify or near ACK is not an exact per-model collision-ready acknowledgement. This is not a guarantee against arbitrarily slow client streaming.
timing_and_limits.scope: Actual phase-visible dynamic gameobject floors. Static terrain/WMO map loading retains its normal protocol. Invalid coordinates, missing collision data and intentional air destinations require their own diagnosis.
timing_and_limits.air_drop: Portal spell 228508's measured air destination remains unchanged; the earlier audit found terrain about 190.7 units below it, not a supporting dynamic platform.
timing_and_limits.protocol_research: The local MoveTeleport PreloadWorld field was inspected but not changed: a field name and newer-client documentation do not establish 7.3.5 collision readiness. No new packet format or invented object-ready ACK was introduced.
